note: Designed sounds for the Crownfall prologue, kept few and quiet on purpose: the creator found the opening film's 33 effects too many and too loud, and preferred the cut with a handful of subtle ones. Each sits well under the voices ('level' in dB against the narrator's loudest 0.4 s: -11 at most, most -15 to -22), and none makes the music dip ('duck': 0); the music only rides the voices. Made with Stable Audio 3.0 Small SFX (Soundbox + audio.cpp, tools/stable_sfx.py). 'at' names a line (cue, edge, offset), a scene, the prologue title (title) or the Chapter One card (chapter).
